content.name: Farhan Qureshi
content.title: IT Support Lead
content.summary: IT support lead with 17 years in Hyderabad, from desktop support in a small office-services firm to running end-user IT for a pharmaceutical company with two manufacturing plants. Leads 14 engineers supporting 2,100 users and brought the plants' shop-floor PCs under central patching for the first time. Experienced with audits, vendor contracts and 24x7 shift rosters.

experience.title: Desktop Support Engineer
bullets: Installed and repaired desktops, printers and LAN cabling for 60 small-business clients on annual maintenance contracts.
Reduced repeat visits by carrying a standard spares kit and logging each fault in a shared register.
Earned my first Microsoft certification within a year and began handling server issues for larger clients.

experience.title: IT Support Engineer (L2)
bullets: Supported 1,500 seats in a 24x7 back-office operation where every idle workstation cost billable hours.
Kept seat availability above 99% during client audits by pre-staging spare thin clients on each floor.
Rolled out Windows 7 to Windows 10 upgrades in phased weekend windows for 1,200 machines.
Trained 20 L1 engineers across three shifts on escalation and documentation standards.

experience.title: Senior IT Support Specialist
bullets: Owned end-user support for 85 collection centres and four labs, coordinating local vendors in six cities.
Introduced remote management tools that let the central team resolve about 60% of centre issues without a site visit.
Cut annual hardware maintenance spend by ₹18 lakh by renegotiating contracts and retiring 300 out-of-warranty PCs.
Ran asset verification for the statutory audit with zero unexplained discrepancies two years running.

experience.title: IT Support Lead
bullets: Lead 14 support engineers across head office and two plants, covering 2,100 users in a 24x7 roster.
Brought 380 shop-floor PCs under central patching and access control, closing a long-standing finding from GxP computer-system audits.
Moved the service desk to ServiceNow with defined SLAs; P1 resolution within four hours rose from 72% to 94%.
Manage a ₹2.1 crore annual end-user IT budget, including laptop refresh and support contracts.

courses.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate

achievements.title: Best Support Team award, Banjara Pharma
achievements.detail: Team recognised by management after the ServiceNow rollout and SLA improvement in 2024.

achievements.title: Guest lecturer
achievements.detail: Teach a yearly session on IT service management to final-year B.Sc students at a local college.
